sentences.en: How does this begin?

上午10点06分。

sentences.en: Committee will come to order.
sentences.zh: 委员会开会。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff, the top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, gavels the hearing room to order.
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会民主党首席成员亚当·希夫敲锤宣布听证会开幕。

sentences.en: He's got the Democrats on the panel to his right, he has the Republicans on the left, and he has two longtime State Department officials sitting in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他右边坐着委员会的民主党人，左边坐着共和党人，在他正前方坐着两位长期任职的外交部官员。

sentences.en: George Kent, who's in charge of basically the State Department's policy towards Ukraine, and Bill Taylor, the acting ambassador to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乔治·肯特，基本上负责国务院对乌克兰政策；以及比尔·泰勒，美国驻乌克兰代理大使。

sentences.en: With that, I now recognize myself to give an opening statement in the impeachment inquiry into Donald J.
sentences.zh: 因此，我现在行使自己的权力，就针对第45任美国总统唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump, the 45th president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的弹劾调查发表开场陈述。

sentences.en: And Schiff begins to lay out his argument for why he believes that what Donald Trump did in regards to Ukraine is so important that he needs to be impeached.
sentences.zh: 接着，希夫开始陈述他的论点，即为什么他认为唐纳德·特朗普在乌克兰问题上的所作所为如此重大，以至于他必须被弹劾。

sentences.en: In 2014, Russia invaded the United States' ally, Ukraine, to reverse that nation's embrace of the West and to fulfill Vladimir Putin's desire to rebuild a Russian empire.
sentences.zh: 2014年，俄罗斯入侵了美国的盟友乌克兰，以扭转该国对西方的拥抱，并实现弗拉基米尔·普京重建俄罗斯帝国的愿望。

sentences.en: Schiff says that Donald Trump tried to take advantage of a country that was in a very vulnerable spot.
sentences.zh: 希夫表示，唐纳德·特朗普试图利用一个处于极度脆弱地位的国家。

sentences.en: 14,000 Ukrainians died as they battled superior Russian forces.
sentences.zh: 14,000名乌克兰人在与装备精良的俄军作战时牺牲。

sentences.en: They needed the United States' support, and perhaps more importantly, its military aid.
sentences.zh: 他们需要美国的支持，或许更重要的是，需要美国的军事援助。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, Vladimir Zelensky was elected president of Ukraine on a platform of ending the conflict and tackling corruption.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基以结束冲突和打击腐败为竞选纲领当选乌克兰总统。

sentences.en: He was a newcomer to politics and immediately sought to establish a relationship with Ukraine's most powerful patron, the United States.
sentences.zh: 他是政治新人，并立即寻求与乌克兰最强大的盟友美国建立关系。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what Schiff seems to be trying to do is to remind the public that the stakes of what was
sentences.zh: 希夫似乎想做的是提醒公众，这里发生的事情，以及大多数人认为的利益交换（quid pro quo），

sentences.en: happening here, and what most people think of as a quid pro quo, was the actual life and death of
sentences.zh: 实际上关乎乌克兰及其人民的生死存亡。

sentences.en: Ukraine and its people.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰及其人民。

sentences.en: The questions presented by this impeachment inquiry are whether President Trump sought to exploit that
sentences.zh: 这次弹劾调查提出的问题是，特朗普总统是否试图利用该盟友的脆弱性，并引诱乌克兰干预我们的选举；

sentences.en: ally's vulnerability and invite Ukraine's interference in our elections, whether President Trump sought to condition official acts such as a White House meeting or U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统是否试图以乌克兰愿意协助两项有助于他竞选连任的政治调查为条件，来换取白宫会晤或美国军事援助等官方行为；以及

sentences.en: military assistance on Ukraine's willingness to assist with two political investigations that would help his re-election campaign, and if
sentences.zh: 军事援助等官方行为；以及

sentences.en: President Trump did either, whether such an abuse of his power is compatible with the office of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普总统做了其中任何一项，这种对权力的滥用是否符合总统职位。

sentences.en: And Schiff poses the question, is this such an egregious thing the president has done that we, as a country, have to take a move that we've only done twice before in history?
sentences.zh: 希夫提出了这样一个问题：总统所做的事情是否如此令人发指，以至于我们作为一个国家，不得不采取历史上只做过两次的行动？

sentences.en: The matter is as simple and as terrible as that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单，也这么可怕。

sentences.en: Our answer to these questions will affect not only the future of this presidency, but the future of the presidency itself.
sentences.zh: 我们对这些问题的回答不仅将影响这个总统职位的未来，也将影响总统职位本身的未来。

sentences.en: And what kind of conduct or misconduct the American people may come to expect from their commander-in-chief.
sentences.zh: 以及美国人民可以期待他们的三军统帅有何种行为或不当行为。

sentences.en: Then, the top Republican on the committee...
sentences.zh: 随后，委员会的共和党首席成员……

sentences.en: Thanks, gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 谢谢各位先生。

sentences.en: ...Devin Nunes gives his opening statement.
sentences.zh: ……德文·努内斯发表开场陈述。

sentences.en: In a July open hearing of this committee, following publication of the Mueller report, the Democrats engaged in a last-ditch effort to convince the American people that President
sentences.zh: 在穆勒报告发布后该委员会7月的一次公开听证会上，民主党人进行了最后的绝望尝试，试图让美国总统相信

sentences.en: Trump is a Russian agent.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是俄罗斯特工。

sentences.en: It starts with him laying out how the Democrats tried as hard as they could to prove that Donald
sentences.zh: 他首先陈述了民主党人如何竭尽全力证明唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump was a Russian agent.
sentences.zh: 特朗普是俄罗斯特工。

sentences.en: That hearing was the pitiful finale of a three-year-long operation by the Democrats, the corrupt media, and partisan bureaucrats to overturn the results of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 那场听证会是民主党人、腐败的媒体和党派官僚历时三年旨在推翻2016年大选结果的行动的悲惨收场。

sentences.en: They failed at that.
sentences.zh: 他们失败了。

sentences.en: Here they go again.
sentences.zh: 他们故态复萌。

sentences.en: They turned on a dime and now claim the real malfeasance is Republicans' dealings with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他们立即变脸，现在声称真正的不当行为是共和党人与乌克兰的交易。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: What we will witness today is a televised, theatrical performance staged by the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我们今天将目睹的是一场由民主党人精心策划的、电视转播的戏剧表演。

sentences.en: He turns to the witnesses.
sentences.zh: 他转向证人。

sentences.en: Ambassador Taylor and Mr. Kent, I'd like to welcome you here.
sentences.zh: 泰勒大使和肯特先生，欢迎你们来到这里。

sentences.en: I'd like to congratulate you for passing the Democrats' Star Chamber auditions held for the last weeks in the basement of the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 我要祝贺你们通过了过去几周在国会山地下室举行的民主党“星室法庭”面试。

sentences.en: You have been recruited by the Democrats because of how well you performed in these private, secret depositions.
sentences.zh: 你们是因为在这些私密、秘密的盘问中表现出色才被民主党招募的。

sentences.en: It seems you agreed, witting or unwittingly, to participate in a drama.
sentences.zh: 看来你们自愿或不自愿地同意参与一出戏剧。

sentences.en: But the main performance, the Russia hoax, has ended.
sentences.zh: 但主剧——“通俄闹剧”已经结束。

sentences.en: And you've been cast in the low-rent Ukrainian sequel.
sentences.zh: 而你们被安排出演低成本的乌克兰续集。

sentences.en: Right before these witnesses even have a chance to utter a word.
sentences.zh: 就在这些证人甚至还没机会说一句话之前。

sentences.en: The top Republican on the committee is besmirching and saying, you're here in cahoots with the
sentences.zh: 委员会的共和党首席成员就在进行污蔑，并称你们是与民主党同流合污，

sentences.en: Democrats, and everything you're about to say is therefore poisoned by that reality.
sentences.zh: 因此你们即将说出的一切都被这个现实所毒害。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This spectacle is doing great damage to our country.
sentences.zh: 这场闹剧对我们的国家造成了极大的损害。

sentences.en: It's nothing more than an impeachment process in search of a crime that I yield back.
sentences.zh: 这不过是一场寻找罪行的弹劾程序，我的发言到此结束。

sentences.en: In response, Schiff starts reading the resumes of the witnesses.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，希夫开始宣读证人的简历。

sentences.en: Ambassador William Taylor has served our country for over half a century.
sentences.zh: 威廉·泰勒大使为我们的国家服务了半个多世纪。

sentences.en: They're the resumes of career diplomats who have served both parties.
sentences.zh: 这些都是曾为两党服务的职业外交官的简历。

sentences.en: In 2006, President Bush nominated him as ambassador to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 2006年，布什总统提名他担任驻乌克兰大使。

sentences.en: And come from backgrounds that are pretty apolitical.
sentences.zh: 他们的背景都相当超然政治。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: My name is George Kent, and I am the deputy assistant secretary of state for Eastern Europe and the caucuses.
sentences.zh: 我叫乔治·肯特，我是负责东欧和高加索事务的副助理国务卿。

sentences.en: And then, when George Kent starts to give his opening statement, I have served proudly as a nonpartisan career Foreign Service officer for more than 27 years
sentences.zh: 然后，当乔治·肯特开始发表开场陈述时，我自豪地作为一名无党派的职业外交官，在五位总统（三位共和党人和两位民主党人）手下服务了27年以上。

sentences.en: under five presidents, three Republican and two Democrat.
sentences.zh: 三位共和党和两位民主党总统。

sentences.en: He sort of echoes that theme.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上呼应了那个主题。

sentences.en: I represent the third generation of my family who have chosen a career in public service and sworn the oath of office that all U.S.
sentences.zh: 我代表家族中第三代选择公共服务事业的人，并宣誓效忠所有美国公务员为捍卫我们的宪法而做的誓词。

sentences.en: public servants do in defense of our Constitution.
sentences.zh: 所有美国公务员为捍卫我们的宪法而做的誓词。

sentences.en: Indeed, there has been a George Kent sworn to defend the Constitution continuously for nearly 60 years.
sentences.zh: 事实上，近60年来，一直有一位宣誓捍卫宪法的乔治·肯特连任不断。

sentences.en: Nunes is trying as hard as he can to paint them as part of this Democratic effort.
sentences.zh: 努内斯正竭尽全力将他们描绘成民主党这一努力的一部分。

sentences.en: And their resumes are rising up and speaking for themselves.
sentences.zh: 而他们的简历正在挺身而出，不言自明。

sentences.en: The United States has very clear national interests at stake in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 美国在乌克兰有着非常明确的国家利益。

sentences.en: Ukraine's success is very much in our national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰的成功极大地符合我们的国家利益。

sentences.en: And it set a tone early on that these two witnesses were going to speak with great authority
sentences.zh: 这很早就定下了基调：这两位证人将以极大的权威性发言，

sentences.en: about not only what happened, but how it fits into the larger story of the United States' foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 不仅谈及发生了什么，还谈及这如何契合美国外交政策的宏大叙事。

sentences.en: Ukraine has been on the front lines, not just of Russia's conventional war in Eastern Europe since 2014 and its broader campaign of malign influence,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰一直处于最前线，不仅是自2014年以来俄罗斯在东欧的常规战争及其更广泛的恶意影响运动的最前线，

sentences.en: but of the greater geopolitical challenges now facing the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且是美国目前面临的更大地缘政治挑战的最前线。

sentences.en: And then it's Bill Taylor's turn.
sentences.zh: 接下来轮到比尔·肯特了。（注：此处按上下文保留或处理，原文为Bill Taylor）

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, I'm appearing today at the committee's request to provide my perspective on the events that are the subject of the committee's inquiry.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我应委员会的要求今天出席，就委员会调查主题的事件提供我的视角。

sentences.en: I want to emphasize at the outset that while I am aware that the committee has requested my testimony as part of impeachment proceedings,
sentences.zh: 我想从一开始就强调，虽然我知道委员会要求我作证是弹劾程序的一部分，

sentences.en: I am not here to take one side or the other.
sentences.zh: 但我来这里不是为了站在哪一边。

sentences.en: And as soon as he begins speaking, his commanding nature and booming voice really start to steal the show.
sentences.zh: 他一开始讲话，其威严的气场和洪亮的声音就真正开始抢尽风头。

sentences.en: Once I arrived in Kiev, I discovered a weird combination of encouraging, confusing, and ultimately alarming circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我一到基辅，就发现了一种令人鼓舞、令人困惑且最终令人震惊的奇异组合。

sentences.en: He starts to describe how American foreign policy was functioning under Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他开始描述美国的外交政策在唐纳德·特朗普领导下是如何运作的。

sentences.en: There appeared to be two channels of U.S.
sentences.zh: 似乎存在着两条美国

sentences.en: policymaking and implementation.
sentences.zh: 决策和执行渠道。

sentences.en: One regular and one highly irregular.
sentences.zh: 一条是常规的，另一条是高度非常规的。

sentences.en: As the acting ambassador, I had authority over the regular, formal diplomatic processes.
sentences.zh: 作为代理大使，我对常规、正式的外交程序拥有管辖权。

sentences.en: There's essentially the American foreign policy on paper, which the State Department and diplomats are trying to carry out.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是纸面上的美国外交政策，国务院和外交官们正试图将其付诸实践。

sentences.en: At the same time, however, I encountered an irregular, informal channel of U.S.
sentences.zh: 然而与此同时，我遇到了关于乌克兰事务的非常规、非正式的美国决策渠道。

sentences.en: policymaking with respect to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰事务的非常规、非正式渠道。

sentences.en: Unaccountable to Congress.
sentences.zh: 不受国会监督。

sentences.en: And then there's this other track.
sentences.zh: 然后还有这条轨道。

sentences.en: I was clearly in the regular channel, but I was also in the irregular one, to the extent that Ambassadors Volker and Sondland including me in certain conversations.
sentences.zh: 我显然处于常规渠道中，但只要伏尔加和桑德兰大使将我纳入某些对话，我也就身处非常规渠道中。

sentences.en: Although this irregular channel was well-connected in Washington, it operated mostly outside of official State Department channels.
sentences.zh: 尽管这条非常规渠道在华盛顿关系网深厚，但它主要在官方国务院渠道之外运作。

sentences.en: That has some diplomats who usually wouldn't deal with Ukraine, and a bit of Rudy Giuliani mixed in.
sentences.zh: 这其中包含一些通常不会与乌克兰打交道的外交官，还掺杂了一点朱利安尼的影子。

sentences.en: I began to sense that these two separate decision-making channels, the regular and the irregular, were separate and at odds.
sentences.zh: 我开始感觉到，这两条独立的决策渠道——常规渠道和非常规渠道，是分开的且互相冲突的。

sentences.en: For those of us that have followed this closely, we're sort of sitting there saying, well, that was in his testimony.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些密切关注此事的人来说，我们有点坐在那里说，好吧，那在他的证词里出现过。

sentences.en: We read that in the transcript that came out last week.
sentences.zh: 我们在上周发布的文字记录中读到了这一点。

sentences.en: But for everyone else in the country, it's bringing this story to life.
sentences.zh: 但对于国内的其他所有人来说，这让这个故事变得生动起来。

sentences.en: It was so important, that security assistance was so important for Ukraine, as well as our own national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这太重要了，安全援助对乌克兰以及我们自己的国家利益都太重要了。

sentences.en: To withhold that assistance, for no good reason, other than help with the political campaign, made no sense.
sentences.zh: 无缘无故地扣留这笔援助，除了帮助政治竞选之外别无他因，这毫无意义。

sentences.en: It was counterproductive to all of what we had been trying to do.
sentences.zh: 这与我们一直试图做的一切适得其反。

sentences.en: It was illogical.
sentences.zh: 这不合逻辑。

sentences.en: It could not be explained.
sentences.zh: 这无法解释。

sentences.en: It was crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So much of this has been laid out in closed-door testimony and in transcripts from that testimony that has been released to the public.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分已经在闭门证词以及向公众发布的该证词文字记录中列出来了。

sentences.en: So we know a lot of what Bill Taylor is saying here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对比尔·泰勒在这里所说的大部分内容都有所了解。

sentences.en: So do we actually learn anything new?
sentences.zh: 那么我们真的学到了什么新东西吗？

sentences.en: Taylor comes with two new pieces of information.
sentences.zh: 泰勒带来了两条新信息。

sentences.en: One of the chief arguments the Trump administration has made is that how could there be a quid pro quo?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府提出的主要论点之一是，怎么可能会有利益交换（quid pro quo）？

sentences.en: Because they didn't know the aid was being held up.
sentences.zh: 因为他们当时并不知道援助被扣留了。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians never really understood the money was being withheld, they argue.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，乌克兰人从未真正明白资金被扣发了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: No harm, no foul.
sentences.zh: 没有伤害，就没有违规。

sentences.en: They didn't know what was going on.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Also on July 20th, I had a phone conversation with Alexander Daniluk,
sentences.zh: 同样在7月20日，我与亚历山大·丹尼柳克进行了电话交谈，

sentences.en: President Zelensky's national security advisor, who emphasized that President Zelensky did not want to be used as an instrument in a U.S.
sentences.zh: 他是泽连斯基总统的国家安全顾问。他强调，泽连斯基总统不希望被当作美国

sentences.en: re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 连任竞选中的工具。

sentences.en: But Taylor begins to describe conversations that he had with Ukrainians that give us a sense that this was being felt by them.
sentences.zh: 但泰勒开始描述他与乌克兰人进行的对话，这让我们感觉到他们确实感受到了这一点。

sentences.en: They were feeling the pressure when he was asking them for the favor.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普向他们索要恩惠时，他们感受到了压力。

sentences.en: I got several questions.
sentences.zh: 我接到了好几个问题。

sentences.en: Other officials got several questions as well from Ukrainians asking about the security assistance.
sentences.zh: 其他官员也接到了乌克兰人关于安全援助的多个提问。

sentences.en: So what I know is the security assistance was very important to the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 所以我所知道的是，安全援助对乌克兰人非常重要。

sentences.en: They had begun to hear from Ambassador Sondland that the security assistance was not going to come until the investigations were pursued.
sentences.zh: 他们开始从桑德兰大使那里听说，如果不开展调查，安全援助就不会到位。

sentences.en: They knew that if they didn't do what Trump wanted, they weren't going to get the thing that they needed.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，如果不按特朗普的要求做，他们就得不到所需的东西。

sentences.en: And it makes the whole ploy more substantive and substantial because the argument's been, they didn't know, but they did.
sentences.zh: 这使得整个计谋更加充实和实质化，因为之前的论点一直是他们不知情，但实际上他们知道。

sentences.en: And Taylor says, here's how I know that.
sentences.zh: 而泰勒说，我是这样知道的。

sentences.en: And what's the second thing?
sentences.zh: 那第二点是什么？

sentences.en: The second thing is new evidence that draws Donald Trump deeper into the story.
sentences.zh: 第二点是新的证据，将唐纳德·特朗普更深地卷入了这个事件中。

sentences.en: Last Friday, a member of my staff told me of events that occurred on July 26th.
sentences.zh: 上周五，我的一名工作人员向我讲述了7月26日发生的事情。

sentences.en: Taylor says, this is not something I saw, but one of my aides the day after the now famous call between Trump and the Ukrainian president
sentences.zh: 泰勒说，这不是我亲眼所见，而是我的一个助手在特朗普与乌克兰总统那场如今声名大噪的通话之后的第二天，

sentences.en: overhears a phone conversation between Trump and a top American diplomat.
sentences.zh: 无意中听到特朗普与一位美国高级外交官的电话交谈。

sentences.en: The member of my staff could hear President Trump on the phone asking Ambassador Sondland about the investigations.
sentences.zh: 我的一名工作人员听到特朗普总统在电话中向桑德兰大使询问有关调查的情况。

sentences.en: Ambassador Sondland told President Trump the Ukrainians were ready to move forward.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰大使告诉特朗普总统，乌克兰人已经准备好向前推进了。

sentences.en: And by investigations, he means the president's desired digging into his political rivals, namely Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 他所说的调查，是指总统希望挖掘其政治对手（即乔·拜登）的黑料。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And after the call, the aide follows up with the American diplomat and says, what was that all about?
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，助手找到这位美国外交官说：这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Following the call with President Trump, the member of my staff asked Ambassador Sondland what President Trump thought about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 在与特朗普总统通话后，我的一名工作人员询问桑德兰大使，特朗普总统对乌克兰是怎么看的。

sentences.en: Ambassador Sondland responded that President Trump cares more about the investigations of Biden, which Giuliani was pressing for.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰大使回答说，特朗普总统更关心朱利安尼一直在极力敦促的对拜登的调查。

sentences.en: And the diplomat said, the thing Trump cares more about is the investigations.
sentences.zh: 这位外交官说，特朗普最关心的事是调查。

sentences.en: More than Ukraine and its security.
sentences.zh: 比乌克兰及其安全还要重要。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So here we are, a day after the famous call, learning about a new incident in which the president
sentences.zh: 所以情况就是这样，在那个著名的通话后的第二天，我们得知了一起新事件，在这起事件中，总统

sentences.en: is reiterating how important these investigations, particularly on the Bidens, are to him.
sentences.zh: 再次重申了这些调查（特别是针对拜登一家的调查）对他是多么重要。

sentences.en: And this is all unfolding, chronologically, at a moment where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从时间线上看，这一切都在发生，当时美国

sentences.en: aid to Ukraine is being withheld, after the president has, as you said, asked for a favor.
sentences.zh: 对乌克兰的援助正被扣留，正如你所说，此前总统已经提出了一个恩惠的要求。

sentences.en: So this is one more data point showing that the president wants Ukraine to do these politically motivated investigations into his rivals.
sentences.zh: 因此，这又是一个数据点，表明总统希望乌克兰对他的对手进行这些出于政治动机的调查。

sentences.en: And it becomes increasingly hard, correct, for anyone to claim that the president's intentions and conduct here are ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 这就变得越来越难以让人声称总统的意图和行为在这里是模棱两可的，对吧？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're building towards a larger narrative of what Trump was up to and what he really wanted.
sentences.zh: 你正在构建一个更宏大的叙事，讲述特朗普当时在搞什么鬼以及他真正想要什么。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, I recognize that this is rather a lengthy recitation of the events of the past few months told from my vantage point in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我承认，这是从我身处基辅的视角出发，对过去几个月发生的事情相当冗长的陈述。

sentences.en: But I also recognize the importance of the matters your committee is investigating.
sentences.zh: 但我也认识到贵委员会正在调查的事项的重要性。

sentences.en: And I hope that this chronology will provide some framework for your questions.
sentences.zh: 我希望这个时间线能为你们的提问提供一些框架。

sentences.en: So at this point, Mike, it feels like the Democrats are pulling off a pretty successful day one of their public hearing, from their perspective.
sentences.zh: 迈克，所以从他们的角度来看，民主党人似乎在第一天的公开听证会上打响了相当成功的一枪。

sentences.en: They are demonstrating that Ukrainian lives were at stake when this money was being withheld in this quid pro quo scheme.
sentences.zh: 他们正在证明，在这个利益交换的阴谋中扣留这笔资金时，乌克兰人的生命正处于危险之中。

sentences.en: They established that the Ukrainians felt the pressure of this arrangement, that it was not abstract to them.
sentences.zh: 他们证实了乌克兰人感受到了这种安排带来的压力，对他们来说这绝非抽象概念。

sentences.en: And finally, they are putting the president directly at the center of this all.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们将总统直接置于这一切的中心。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're adding new details that bolster their story.
sentences.zh: 他们正在加入新的细节来巩固他们的说法。

sentences.en: And for the first day of testimony, that's a pretty good accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 对于作证的第一天来说，这已经是一个相当不错的成就了。

sentences.en: But then the Republicans have a chance to ask questions.
sentences.zh: 但接下来轮到共和党人提问了。

sentences.en: And they have a pretty effective strategy of their own.
sentences.zh: 他们也有自己相当有效的策略。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请在今天下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Mike, once Republicans get to ask these two witnesses questions, what does their strategy actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，一旦共和党人有机会向这两位证人提问，他们的策略究竟是怎样的？

sentences.en: One by one, the Republican representatives try and water down the Democrats' argument.
sentences.zh: 共和党众议员逐一试图淡化民主党人的论点。

sentences.en: They take on the issue of whether the Ukrainians truly felt pressure to commit to these investigations.
sentences.zh: 他们着手处理乌克兰人是否真的感受到承诺进行这些调查的压力的议题。

sentences.en: Note this important fact.
sentences.zh: 请注意这个重要事实。

sentences.en: The security assistance was provided to Ukraine without the Ukrainians having done any of the things they were supposedly being blackmailed to do.
sentences.zh: 在乌克兰人根本没有做任何他们被指控遭到勒索去做的事情的情况下，安全援助就被提供给了乌克兰。

sentences.en: And when the Ukrainians were asked, did you feel pressure from Donald Trump to do this?
sentences.zh: 当被问及“你们是否感受到唐纳德·特朗普要求你们这样做的压力”时，

sentences.en: Ukrainians said no.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人回答说没有。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian president stood in front of the world press and repeatedly, consistently, over
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统站在世界新闻界面前，在一场又一场的采访中，反复地、坚持不懈地、

sentences.en: and over again, interview after interview, said he had no knowledge of military aid being
sentences.zh: 一次又一次地表示，他根本不知道军事援助被

sentences.en: withheld, meaning no quid pro quo, no pressure, no demands, no threats, no blackmail, nothing corrupt.
sentences.zh: 扣留，这意味着没有利益交换、没有施压、没有要求、没有威胁、没有勒索，没有任何腐败行为。

sentences.en: So, this is a clear strategy of trying to take the air out of what the Democrats are arguing
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一个明确的策略，旨在卸掉民主党人辩论中的气势，

sentences.en: and saying instead, so there's always talk for quid pro quo, but actually the military aid gets to the Ukrainians, so that takes away one half of it.
sentences.zh: 转而声称：虽然总有人谈论利益交换，但实际上军事援助还是送到了乌克兰人手中，这就消解了一半的指控。

sentences.en: And those investigations that were sought, they never happened, which they argue takes away the other half of it.
sentences.zh: 而那些被寻求的调查从未发生过，他们认为这消解了另一半的指控。

sentences.en: It's the argument of quid pro so?
sentences.zh: 这就是“利益交换又如何”的论点吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what?
sentences.zh: 那又怎样？

sentences.en: I mean, can both those things be true, though, that you can ask for something and not get it and it still be wrong?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这两件事难道不能同时成立吗：你可以索要某物但最终没得到，而这依然是错误的？

sentences.en: Well, the Democrats, when they try and come back and clean this up, say, is attempted murder a crime?
sentences.zh: 嗯，民主党人在试图反击并澄清这一点时会说，谋杀未遂是犯罪吗？

sentences.en: Is attempted robbery a crime?
sentences.zh: 抢劫未遂是犯罪吗？

sentences.en: Even if Donald Trump didn't succeed in this, he tried.
sentences.zh: 即使唐纳德·特朗普没有得逞，他尝试过了。

sentences.en: And that matters.
sentences.zh: 这才是重点。

sentences.en: But how do the Republicans on this panel grapple with the new revelations that appear pretty damning from Bill Taylor?
sentences.zh: 但该小组的共和党人将如何应对比尔·泰勒带来、看起来相当致命的新爆料呢？

sentences.en: Ambassador Taylor, the reason why the Sixth Amendment doesn't allow hearsay is because it's unreliable.
sentences.zh: 泰勒大使，第六修正案之所以不允许传闻证据，是因为它不可靠。

sentences.en: It's unreliable because frequently it's untruthful.
sentences.zh: 它之所以不可靠，是因为它往往是不真实的。

sentences.en: They say it's hearsay.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是传闻。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Ambassador, you testified about a number of things that you heard.
sentences.zh: 大使先生，你作证时谈到了许多你听到的事情。

sentences.en: Isn't it possible that the things that you heard were not true?
sentences.zh: 难道那些你听到的事情有没有可能并不是真的？

sentences.en: That some of the beliefs and understandings that you had are not accurate?
sentences.zh: 你所持有的一些信念和理解并不准确？

sentences.en: That, in fact, you're mistaken about some of the things that you testified today on a factual basis.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你在今天作证时对某些事实的陈述是搞错了的。

sentences.en: Was that staffer that Taylor was talking about?
sentences.zh: 泰勒所说的那位工作人员是谁？

sentences.en: Was that staffer talking to the president?
sentences.zh: 那个工作人员是在跟总统对话吗？

sentences.en: No, that staffer was not.
sentences.zh: 不，那个工作人员并没有。

sentences.en: The staffer just overheard that conversation.
sentences.zh: 这位工作人员只是无意中听到了那段对话。

sentences.en: And by the way, that staffer then conveys it to you, Bill Taylor, so it's essentially third hand.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，然后这位工作人员把话传给了你，比尔·泰勒，所以这基本上已经是第三手了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the Republicans asked Kent and Taylor.
sentences.zh: 共和党人质问肯特和泰勒。

sentences.en: You weren't on the call, were you?
sentences.zh: 你们当时不在通话中，对吧？

sentences.en: The president, you didn't listen on President Trump's call and President Lissi's call?
sentences.zh: 总统，你们没有旁听特朗普总统和泽连斯基总统的通话吗？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: Did you ever talk to the president about the quid pro quo?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有跟总统谈过关于利益交换的事？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: You've never talked with Chief of Staff Mulvaney?
sentences.zh: 你们从来没有跟幕僚长马尔瓦尼交谈过？

sentences.en: I never did.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有。

sentences.en: Did you ever talk to the president?
sentences.zh: 你跟总统交谈过吗？

sentences.en: You never met the president?
sentences.zh: 你从来没见过总统？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: This is what I can't believe.
sentences.zh: 这是我最难以置信的地方。

sentences.en: And you're their star witness.
sentences.zh: 而你却是他们的王牌证人。

sentences.en: You're their first witness.
sentences.zh: 你是他们的第一位证人。

sentences.en: So, where are these first-hand accounts?
sentences.zh: 那么，那些第一手证词在哪里呢？

sentences.en: If we're going to impeach the president and remove him from office, where is the direct evidence tying him to this?
sentences.zh: 如果我们打算弹劾总统并将其罢免，那么将他与此事联系起来的直接证据在哪里？

sentences.en: Why is it important that those two diplomats did or didn't have a conversation with the president?
sentences.zh: 为什么这两位外交官有没有跟总统对话过会这么重要？

sentences.en: As best I can tell, all the testimony so far has been from career diplomats who are essentially
sentences.zh: 据我所能判断的，迄今为止所有的证词都来自于职业外交官，他们基本上

sentences.en: in the middle of the bureaucracy and experienced what they regarded as this improper scheme in the places where they were, not as people who work directly with the president.
sentences.zh: 处于官僚体系的中层，在他们各自的岗位上体验到了他们认为的不当阴谋，而不是作为与总统直接共事的人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Much of the testimony so far has been from this sort of second layer of folks who were not directly talking to the president.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止的大多数证词都来自于这种第二层级的人员，他们并没有直接与总统对话。

sentences.en: And I think what the Republicans are trying to say is that if we are going to take this extreme measure of removing a president for the first time in American history, we need
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人试图表达的是，如果我们要在美国历史上首次采取罢免总统这一极端措施，我们需要

sentences.en: more evidence than just these people who were not talking directly to Trump.
sentences.zh: 比这些没有直接与特朗普对话的人更多的证据。

sentences.en: Over the next few weeks, we're going to have more witnesses.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，我们还会有更多证人。

sentences.en: Like we've had today that the Democrats will parade in here and they're all going to say
sentences.zh: 就像我们今天看到的那样，民主党人会把他们带到这里来，而他们都会说：

sentences.en: this, so-and-so said such-and-such to so-and-so, and therefore, we got to impeach the president.
sentences.zh: 某某对某某说了这样那样的话，因此我们必须弹劾总统。

sentences.en: That's what we're going to hear.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将会听到的。

sentences.en: So by that argument, Republicans seem to be making the case that until they hear directly from a witness who heard something directly from the president, they are not going to be
sentences.zh: 因此根据这一论点，共和党人似乎在制造这样一种看法：在他们直接听到某个证人亲耳听到总统的话之前，他们是绝不会被

sentences.en: persuaded.
sentences.zh: 说服的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's a little disingenuous because the White House is blocking those people closest to the president from talking to Congress.
sentences.zh: 这有点虚伪，因为白宫正在阻止那些最接近总统的人与国会对话。

sentences.en: So in that sense, it's kind of a convenient strategy.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，这算是一种很方便的策略。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But is it effective?
sentences.zh: 但它有效吗？

sentences.en: It starts to build room for Senate Republicans to say, we do not have enough evidence directly tying Trump to this.
sentences.zh: 它开始为参议院的共和党人腾出空间，让他们可以说：我们没有足够的直接证据将特朗普与此事联系起来。

sentences.en: And it begins to open up that gap and water down the Democrats' argument that this is something Trump should be removed for.
sentences.zh: 它开始撕开这个缺口，并淡化了民主党人的论点，即这是应该罢免特朗普的理由。

sentences.en: It feels like this line of questioning from the Republicans, especially the hearsay argument,
sentences.zh: 感觉共和党人的这一系列质问，尤其是传闻证据的辩论，

sentences.en: reveals a pretty complicated reality for the Democrats who are running these hearings, which
sentences.zh: 揭示了正在主持这些听证会的民主党人面临的一个相当复杂的现实，

sentences.en: is it's easy to poke holes in the case for impeachment, whereas it's relatively difficult to make a highly
sentences.zh: 那就是挑出弹劾案中的漏洞很容易，而要向整个国家提出一个极具说服力的弹劾理由却相对困难，正如你所说，尤其是当白宫正在阻挠那些能与总统进行最直接接触的证人时。

sentences.en: compelling case to the whole country for impeachment, as you said, especially when the White House is blocking the witnesses with the most direct access to the president.
sentences.zh: 没有这些证人，民主党人就好像是绑着一只手在战斗。

sentences.en: Without those witnesses, the Democrats are sort of fighting with one hand tied behind their back.
sentences.zh: 他们无法接触到最接近特朗普的人。

sentences.en: They do not have access to those closest to Trump.
sentences.zh: 为了采取如此严厉的行动，共和党人会说：那些证词在哪里？

sentences.en: And to take such a severe move, Republicans are going to say, where are those accounts?
sentences.zh: 那些证据在哪里？

sentences.en: Where is that evidence?
sentences.zh: 而这正是民主党人将举步维艰的地方。

sentences.en: And that's where the Democrats will struggle.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，或者说在接下来的几天里，我们将听到其他敬业的公仆的声音。

sentences.en: Over the weeks to come, or over the days to come, rather, we will hear from other dedicated public servants.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，这场听证会将如何收场？

sentences.en: So, Mike, how does this hearing come to an end?
sentences.zh: 在共和党人、民主党人和证人之间进行了六个小时的来回交锋之后，

sentences.en: After six hours of back and forth between the Republicans and the Democrats and the witnesses,
sentences.zh: 希夫对听证会进行了总结陈词，并再次试图提醒人们这里的利害关系是什么。

sentences.en: Schiff sort of bookends the hearing and tries again to remind people of what was at stake here.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们将不得不根据你和其他人

sentences.en: At the end of the day, we're going to have to decide, based on the evidence that you and others
sentences.zh: 提供的证据做出决定：我们是否准备好接受这样一种情况，即总统可以附加条件来提供

sentences.en: provide, whether we're prepared to accept a situation where the president can condition
sentences.zh: 军事援助、外交会晤或任何其他官方行为的履行，以便在连任竞选中获得帮助。

sentences.en: military aid, diplomatic meetings, or any other performance of an official act in order to get help in their re-election.
sentences.zh: 军事援助、外交会晤或为了争取连任而履行的任何其他公务行为。

sentences.en: And why this was so important.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么这如此重要。

sentences.en: With that, this concludes this portion of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 至此，听证会的这一部分结束。

sentences.en: And he gavels it to a close.
sentences.zh: 他敲锤宣布闭会。

sentences.en: When we resume shortly, we'll take up Mr. Conovey's motion.
sentences.zh: 稍事休息后，我们将审议科诺韦先生的动议。

sentences.en: Mike, this hearing was designed very much for the public.
sentences.zh: 迈克，这场听证会很大程度上是为了公众而设的。

sentences.en: And it was the first time that the public got a chance to meet these career Foreign Service officers who believe that the president did something wrong here.
sentences.zh: 这也是公众第一次有机会见到这些职业外交官，他们认为总统在这里做错了事。

sentences.en: So, what do you think that that public will take away from this day?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为公众从今天会得到什么感悟？

sentences.en: They will have seen two witnesses in Kent and Taylor who saw things that they thought were real probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他们会看到肯特和泰勒这两位证人，他们看到了自认为是真正问题的事情。

sentences.en: They had been in government a long time, and this thing came along and could be real trouble in terms of life and death.
sentences.zh: 他们在政府工作了很长时间，而这件事的出现，在生死攸关方面可能会带来真正的麻烦。

sentences.en: Up until this point, we had heard about these concerns.
sentences.zh: 直到这一刻，我们才听到这些担忧。

sentences.en: We had read about them.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经读到过它们。

sentences.en: But today, in Bill Taylor's voice, you felt them, and that was different.
sentences.zh: 但今天，在比尔·泰勒的声音里，你感受到了它们，那是不同的。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, as the Republicans would point out, the thing they most feared, what
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，正如共和党人会指出的那样，他们最害怕的事情，也就是

sentences.en: Bill Taylor was so scared of, didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 比尔·泰勒如此害怕的事情，并没有发生。

sentences.en: It didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 它没有发生。

sentences.en: And that dilutes the importance of it.
sentences.zh: 这削弱了其重要性。

sentences.en: Which suddenly creates an intriguing question that I suppose may hang over the rest of all these hearings.
sentences.zh: 这突然引发了一个引人入胜的问题，我想这可能会笼罩在所有这些听证会的其余部分之上。

sentences.en: Are the president's motivations, are his proven conduct, no matter what the outcome, no matter
sentences.zh: 总统的动机、他被证实的行径，无论结果如何，无论

sentences.en: if the thing he plotted and schemed happened or didn't happen, is the fact that he wanted it to happen and he put it in motion, is that enough to be impeached?
sentences.zh: 他密谋策划的事情有没有发生，他想要它发生并将其实施这一事实，是否足以构成弹劾的理由？

sentences.en: It's a reoccurring theme in the Trump story.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普故事中反复出现的主题。

sentences.en: The president tries to do something, but ultimately is not effective enough to actually get it done.
sentences.zh: 总统试图做某事，但最终效果不够，没能真正完成。

sentences.en: So should we penalize him for those attempts?
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否应该为这些尝试惩罚他？

sentences.en: Is the attempt and everything that goes into it and everything that gets set in motion reach that bar for Congress to remove the president?
sentences.zh: 这种尝试及其包含的一切、所有付诸实施的一切，是否达到了国会罢免总统的标准？

sentences.en: And that's where the debate may be in the coming weeks for the rest of these hearings.
sentences.zh: 这可能是未来几周其余听证会进行辩论的地方。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the president of the United States and the president of the Republic of Turkey.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，美利坚合众国总统和土耳其共和国总统。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump hosted Turkey's president, Recep Tayyip Erdogan, at the White House, despite the fact that Turkey has invaded Syria in a widely condemned operation
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统在白宫接待了土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安，尽管土耳其在一次受到广泛谴责的军事行动中入侵了叙利亚
zh_words: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

sentences.en: that killed Kurdish allies of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并杀害了美国的库尔德盟友。

sentences.en: We've assured each other that Turkey will continue to uphold what it's supposed to uphold.
sentences.zh: 我们向彼此保证，土耳其将继续履行其应当履行的职责。

sentences.en: I'm a big fan of the president, to tell you that.
sentences.zh: 老实跟你说，我是这位总统的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: During a joint news conference with Erdogan, Trump declined to criticize Erdogan for the operation, instead praising him for reaching a ceasefire in Syria.
sentences.zh: 在与埃尔多安的联合新闻发布会上，特朗普拒绝就此次行动批评埃尔多安，反而称赞他达成了叙利亚停火协议。

sentences.en: And I know that the ceasefire, while complicated, is moving forward and moving forward at a very rapid clip.
sentences.zh: 我知道停火协议虽然复杂，但正在推进，而且推进速度非常快。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that the former governor of Massachusetts, Deval Patrick, has told senior Democrats that he will enter the presidential race,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，马萨诸塞州前州长德瓦尔·帕特里克已向资深民主党人表示，他将参加总统竞选，

sentences.en: adding even more volatility to an already unusually fluid Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 这为原本就已经不同寻常多变的民主党初选增添了更多的不确定性。

sentences.en: Patrick's decision comes just three months before the Iowa caucuses, and days after the former mayor of New York City, Mike Bloomberg,
sentences.zh: 帕特里克的决定正值艾奥瓦州党团会议前夕的三个月，就在纽约市前市长迈克·布隆伯格

sentences.en: took steps of his own to enter the Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 采取行动宣布参加民主党初选几天后。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自封为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。
